preconditions.description: Input X and d are integers within the specified bounds [1, 10^9].
X and d are valid integers.

postconditions.expression: output_lines == ['-1'] or (len(output_lines) == 2 and 1 <= n <= 10000 and all(1 <= x < 10**18 for x in arr) and count_valid_subsequences(arr, d) == X)
postconditions.description: If no solution exists, output is -1. Otherwise, output contains n (1 <= n <= 10000) and an array of n positive integers < 10^18 such that the count of non-empty subsequences where max - min < d equals X.

postconditions.expression: count_valid_subsequences(arr, d) == sum(1 for sub in get_all_subsequences(arr) if max(sub) - min(sub) < d)
postconditions.description: The count of valid subsequences is exactly the number of non-empty subsequences where the difference between the maximum and minimum element is strictly less than d.
